title: BeforeModel output
description: Adjusts this request only; Zed history is never changed. No deny: a hook never cuts the model. Exit code 2 or a `decision` field is a non-blocking failure, logged with its reason; the request is sent. Closed: this event has no Claude Code counterpart to stay compatible with.

systemMessage.description: Warning shown to the user in the agent panel.

hookEventName.description: Must be this event name; a mismatch is a hook failure.

max_output_tokens.description: Lowers the output ceiling of this request. A value above the current one is ignored.

tool_result_replacements.description: Tool results to replace in this request only (for example a shortened result with a note).

tool_use_id.description: Id of the tool call whose result is replaced.

text.description: Replacement text, including the note for the model.

system_prompt_insert.description: Text inserted into the system message of THIS request only, right before the `## System Information` heading of the Zed template (crates/agent/src/templates/system_prompt.hbs:144); if that heading is not found, at the end of the system message, and Zed writes a log line. Several hooks: texts are joined in declaration order (chain rule), separated by a blank line. The hook MUST return the same text from one request to the next while its inputs do not change: the server reuses the cached prompt prefix, and a text that changes (time, counter, random order) invalidates that cache on every request. Ignored for the compaction request (is_compaction true). At most 10000 characters for the JOINED text of all hooks of one request, the cap Claude Code puts on additionalContext (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1054): the text is resent with every request and counts in the context window. Beyond it, the inserts of the following hooks are ignored and logged.
